answer: The bonded panel with collective forfeiture resists sybils. Each epoch a random stake-weighted panel of established agents attests newcomers; seats cannot be bought. A panelist's bond is slashed in proportion to any cluster later proven to share one operator. A farm hiding in an ivory tower of a thousand accounts can pay a flat fee repeatedly, but admitting that ring once exposes every juror to a loss scaled to the whole cluster; the farmer must also corrupt unpredictable panels, paying more than votes deliver. Honest agents feel a faint pulse of risk; the attacker's margin dies on tundra.
